title: Заморозить resource envelope и провести cross-contract gate P1
summary: Собрать versioned inventory входных/resource limits и repeatable benchmark protocol, затем доказать связность всех P1 contracts для P2–P10.
why: Сейчас измеримы лишь часть лимитов (expression `32/512/1000/10000`, scenario steps `64`, baggage `64/8192`), а token bytes, argument/event/result sizes, pagination и process-local replay collection не ограничены. Absolute timing gate без calibrated runner даст false RED/GREEN. `RAG:—` (PHP/Dart code and audit «Производительность»).

include: Implemented/missing/configurable limit registry; units and counting semantics across PHP/Dart; owner phases; boundary/over-limit tests; benchmark workloads for JCS, schema validation, descriptor digest, event fold, contention, token verify, differential runner and snapshot restore; environment fingerprint, warmup/sample/statistics protocol; cross-contract coverage gate and downstream notification map.
exclude: Implementing limits or benchmark harness; choosing universal performance SLOs; comparing unlike machines; making benchmark timing a PR blocker before P8 calibration; runtime/package fixes.

rules: Every limit row has stable `RL-###`, unit, counting rule, current PHP value/status, current Dart value/status, configuration semantics, owner and required boundary evidence. `missing` is valid baseline truth and never silently assigned a number. Cross-language equal numbers are not enough: byte/code-unit/item counting differences are explicit. Benchmark baselines bind commit, tool/runtime versions, machine fingerprint and raw sample artifact; P8 alone may set regression gates after calibration. Update `@plan/plan.json` Exported contracts from draft to exact v1 paths only after the coverage gate is green.
guidance: Include audit candidates: token/arguments/event/page/scenario/expression/string/unknown-extension/audit-baggage/result sizes and replay-store retention. Keep workload definitions deterministic and generated inputs hashable; exclude network and wall-clock external services. `@plan/knowledge/findings-P1-contract-coverage.json` maps F01–F14, `TM-*`, `G-*`/`NG-*`, migrations and `RL-*` to exactly one downstream owner/proof class.
deliverables: Resource-envelope/benchmark contract, complete P1 cross-contract coverage report, and versioned PLAN1 Exported-contract rows ready for P2–P10 consumption.

result.notes:
Post-audit reaffirm: resource-envelope RL-001–RL-025 single owners; P1-contract-coverage PASS; validate_resource_envelope_v1.py rejects composite RL owners.
